text: In the planned California community of Cuesta Verde, five-year-old Carol Anne Freeling [talks to the static on the television|images|pictures, screens and recordings] until a ghostly hand reaches out of the screen. Silverware bends and furniture moves on its own, then in a thunderstorm the backyard tree seizes her brother and [Carol Anne is pulled into a portal in the closet|wants|a child to take or have]. Her parents Steve and Diane learn that their home stands on [a former cemetery|wrong|disturbing the dead], and a medium places their daughter among [spirits who have not found rest|threat|the restless dead].
